text:
sam: heads-up, p99 spike on us-east-runtime-3 starting ~09:12 UTC, sustained ~6m. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/rtp/kvcache?from=now-15m , logs show lots of kernel_select timeouts + kvcache evictions.

maria: saw that too, eviction rate jumped 4x. sounds like prefetch path thrashing with short-seq workload. quick look at flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/fg/1735019999

alex: can you paste a short log snippet?

sam: snippet: ```
[09:12:07] kernel_select: chosen=jit_v2 fallback=slow_kernel
[09:12:07] kvcache: evict tenant=342 entries=128 reason=hotstripe
[09:12:08] kernel_select: timeout_ms=50
```

maria: that tenant 342 has a bursty chat app (short seq, lots of new prefixes). our selector prefers prefetch which increases KV pressure.

incident-bot: INCIDENT_CREATED INC-2026-0421 latency_spike us-east-runtime-3

alex: mitigation plan: 1) throttle tenant 342 to 30rps 2) flip kernel_prefetch feature flag off on pool r3 3) route new shortseq traffic to quantized-128 fallback. can we do 1 & 2 now?

sam: doing throttle now: `redwoodctl tenant throttle set 342 --rps 30 --reason "emergency p99"`

metrics-bot: tenant 342 throttle applied (30 rps) — effective within 12s

maria: flipping flag in feature-store for pool r3: `featurectl set runtime.kernel_prefetch false --pool r3 --ephemeral`

deploy-bot: feature flag update pushed to config-store, rolling config refresh on r3

alex: routing change (non-disruptive): add route rule for tenant 342 -> model=quantized-128, fallback=true. `routerctl add-rule --tenant 342 --model quantized-128 --priority 10`

sam: route added.

maria: watching evictions and kernel_select latencies. looks like evictions dropping immediately. p95 stable, p99 trending down.

metrics-bot: p99 latency (us-east-runtime-3) 09:12 before: 520ms -> after throttle/flag/route: 120ms (5m window)

alex: nice. can we keep the throttle and the flag until we ship a proper selector fallback? I can open a small perf PR to change the cost heuristic to penalize prefetch when kvcache_evictions_rate > 1.5x baseline.

sam: yes keep throttle and flag. filed follow-up: https://jira.redwood/browse/RINF-1724 (selector heuristic + unit tests + perf bench).

maria: ops note: we should add a shortseq workload to the regression suite and run on r3 with and without prefetch. also add a synthetic to exercise eviction path.

incident-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE INC-2026-0421 status=mitigated notes="throttle+flag+route applied; p99 reduced"

deploy-bot: rolling restart not required. config-only changes.

sam: postmortem owner assigned to maria. will include timelines, flamegraphs, and the PR link. tentative RCA: kernel prefetch heuristic didn't consider transient hotstripe evictions for bursty short-seq tenants.

alex: temporary mitigation checklist: throttle tenant 342 (still on), kernel_prefetch=false on r3 (ephemeral), route rule in place.

maria: I'll run perf bench + unit tests today and try to get PR out by EOD.

sam: thanks team :thumbsup: closing thread once postmortem is published.

metrics-bot: INCIDENT_RESOLVED INC-2026-0421 resolved_by=sam resolved_at=1735021400
